items.title: Jon Hendricks interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Oh Louis asked me what it was and he’s just worried about getting ripped off, like all jazz musicians. And I said no, no, no, this is archival.

ctx.x: Oh Louis asked me what it was and he’s just worried about getting ripped off, like all jazz musicians. And I said no, no, no, this is archival. That means 50 years from now students will be able to walk into Hamilton and say, “that’s Louis Hayes. He was a great drummer.” And I told him, what do you think I’m doing here. You know I’m doing mine now. And he said, “okay, tell Monk I’ll do it.”
